, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Julius Caesar’s 55–54 BC raids (Roman Republic) with the actual AD 43 conquest under the Roman Empire and finalized “Roman Republic” despite earlier evidence indicating the correct conqueror was the Roman Empire.
